shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded patch between two curves on coordinate axes. On the left, use the gray patch underneath the horizontal axis between the blue and orange curves, immediately to the right of the vertical axis. On the right, use the shaded patch marked R2 between the orange sine and blue cosine traces at the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It selects the area between the two traces from the vertical axis to their first intersection on the right. Right image: It selects a region between the two functions on the displayed x-interval.
Rationales: The fill selects the gap between the two plotted functions over a specific horizontal interval. The upper value minus the lower value gives the local height of that region.
